text: When I arrived, there was some line, but the queue moved quickly, so I didn’t have to wait long to see the doctor. The doctor was professional and efficient. He asked relevant questions and performed the tests and ultrasound promptly. While he seemed a bit rushed and spoke quickly, I still felt that he explained everything clearly. There wasn’t much time for additional questions, but overall, the consultation went smoothly. The price was reasonable, and it seemed more affordable compared to private hospitals on Koh Samui. Highly recommend

text: This is probably the worst clinic to go to as a foreigner. If you have a serious condition or chronic problem don't waste your time. Went there three times as it is the nearest clinic but everytime walked out shocked, as I felt worse after the consultation.  I always though it is me but nope. So if you don't have a fever or high blood pressure then you are not sick. If you are not coughing and sneezing and visably sick also stay away.If you are overweight also stay away. You can't say how you feel as it is to much effort to check or test or even get up from behind the desk and you are lying because "you want to go to a beach party"..really.  Insults are like candy you get it free and then pay for it in the front. Staff is kind and helpfull but that is all I can say. Had to go to another clinic after to get assistance. Rather go to the hospital.  You won't be sick and then get crap for asking for help.
